correctness.rationale: The exact facet formula {i,i+1,i+2} and {i,i+2,i+8} modulo 14 yields 14 vertices, 42 edges, 28 triangles, 28 and only 28 graph triangles and no 4-cliques, hence flag. Contract the explicit spanning path 0–1–…–13: the 28x29 relation matrix of triangle boundaries has Smith diagonal twenty-seven 1s and one 2, giving H1=Z⊕Z/2. Independently enumerating every undirected simple 4-cycle returns 77; reduced mod-2 and integral free coordinates partition them as 42 null, 21 nonzero torsion, 14 primitive free. All 28 simple triangles are facet boundaries; hence the 35 nontrivial four-cycles are shortest nonzero-integral-homology simple cycles. Translation action by one has the claimed orbit sizes 14,7,14. This uses exact whole finite enumeration and independent SymPy Smith form, not an inference from verifier logs.
residual_risks: Datta–Upadhyay and Bibby et al. full texts read, but no global indexed census of Klein-bottle flag triangulations was exhaustively searched; an unindexed computation may contain some of these finite counts.

This is a reusable exact finite topological invariant rather than an arbitrary small graph test. It does not purport to classify every Klein bottle or non-simple cycle; its narrow domain limits breadth but not the mathematical motivation.
